case_number: 2024 INSC 341; WRIT PETITION (CIVIL) NO. 434 OF 2023 AND WRIT PETITION (CIVIL) NO. 184 OF 2024

parties.respondent: Election Commission Of India and Another

summary: Challenge to EVM-VVPAT system integrity; no allegation of malice against ECI; demand for 100% VVPAT verification; translucent VVPAT window modification contested; Rule 49MA validity challenged; reference to prior precedents (Subramanian Swamy, Chandrababu Naidu); EVMs upheld as ensuring free/fair elections; gradual VVPAT adoption mandated in 2013; 5-machine random verification ordered in 2019; current petition dismissed following settled law on EVM validity.
final_judgment: Delay in refiling condoned; petition dismissed following precedent affirming EVM-VVPAT system validity and rejecting return to ballot papers or 100% VVPAT verification.
